claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised his place at 619 Market street, St. Louis, with concerts every evening and the best of singers only engaged.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of world, 619 Market street. gee evening. The best of singers only engaged.

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world in a March 1891 advertisement.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of world, 619 Market street.

notes: Only the Sporting Notes advertisement mentions Allen; the rest of the page is unrelated. The line 'gee evening' is garbled OCR, read as the concert notice.
